Enum Class ProgressState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ProgressState>
net.tessel.fx.ProgressState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ProgressState>, Constable
public enum ProgressState extends Enum<ProgressState>
The state of a progress bar or progress ring: the normal accent color, paused (warning), failed (error) or finished (success). Set it with Tessel.progressState(javafx.scene.Node, ProgressState) on a ProgressBar / ProgressIndicator, or with ProgressRing.setState.

A paused or failed indeterminate indicator stops animating.
